title: Individualized antisense oligonucleotides for SCN2A-related developmental epileptic encephalopathy.
abstract: Allele-selective ASOs targeting intronic SNPs reduced mutant SCN2A transcript in two boys with SCN2A-DEE; seizures fell 26% and 90% with neurodevelopmental gains; 16% of a separate SCN2A-RD cohort had compatible SNPs for allele-selective targeting.
